description: This file implements various executor mappers and decorators for high-level DU (Distributed Unit) task execution management, including dedicated, strand-based, and UE-based executor mappings, with support for tracing and metrics.

classes.name: executor_decorator
classes.description: Helper class to decorate executors with additional functionalities such as tracing, metrics, and throttling.

classes.name: dedicated_cell_worker_executor_mapper
classes.description: Maps cell executors using dedicated serialized workers, one per cell.

classes.name: strand_cell_worker_executor_mapper
classes.description: Maps cell executors using a thread pool with one strand per cell.

classes.name: common_ue_executor_mapper
classes.description: Base class for UE executor mappers, managing strands for UEs.

classes.name: index_based_ue_executor_mapper
classes.description: Maps UEs based on their RNTI (index-based mapping).

classes.name: pcell_ue_executor_mapper
classes.description: Maps UEs based on their PCell, with a fixed mapping per UE.

classes.name: ctrl_executor_mapper
classes.description: Manages control-plane task execution with prioritized strands.

classes.name: du_high_executor_mapper_impl
classes.description: Main implementation of the high-level DU executor mapper, integrating cell, UE, and control mappers.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Decorates an executor with tracing, metrics, and throttling based on configuration.

methods.name: mac_cell_executor
methods.description: Returns the executor for MAC cell tasks based on cell index.

methods.name: rlc_lower_executor
methods.description: Returns the executor for RLC lower tasks based on cell index.

methods.name: slot_ind_executor
methods.description: Returns the executor for slot indication tasks based on cell index.

methods.name: ctrl_executor
methods.description: Returns the control plane executor for a given UE index.

methods.name: f1u_dl_pdu_executor
methods.description: Returns the F1-U downlink PDU executor for a given UE index.

methods.name: f1c_dl_sdu_executor
methods.description: Returns the F1-C downlink SDU executor for a given UE index.

methods.name: mac_ul_pdu_executor
methods.description: Returns the MAC uplink PDU executor for a given UE index.
